Поръчките идват всеки ден. „Предложи“ —: New orders arrive every day. “Propose” sends your bid; the −15%…+20% buttons lower or raise the price (cheaper — better chance). 30% advance on acceptance, the rest on completion.
Тук са обектите ти: етап, прогрес и срок: Your sites: stage, progress and deadline. Equipment drives there by itself; if something is missing (materials, a machine), it shows up here.
Машините и бусовете на фирмата. Повече т: Your company’s machines and vans. More equipment — more sites at once. The garage (in “Empire”) sets how many fit.
Материалите за обектите. Купуват се сами: Materials for your sites. They are bought automatically when you have money; you can also stock up in advance, cheaper in bulk.
Имоти: купуваш къщи и празни парцели, ст: Property: buy houses and vacant plots, build, then sell or rent out.
Офисът определя колко бригади и обекти н: The office sets how many crews and sites you can run at once. Upgrade it as your company grows; from level 7 you choose your tower’s look.
Картата: градовете, магистралите, жп лин: The map: cities, motorways, railways and sea routes. Open branches and build links between cities here.
„Империя“ събира всичко отвъд първия гра: “Empire” gathers everything beyond your first city: garage, transport, resorts, bank, quests… New things appear here as you level up.
🎓 Готово! Сега си сам — успех!: 🎓 All done! You’re on your own now — good luck!
